criteria.name: identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue Events imagery identifies Felix Haas Hall and supports its red roof and signature front; Purdue Archives dates the former Memorial Gymnasium to 1908. The GIS shell was unchanged from the earlier shell review. Round-11 evidence still treats photo-derived form as qualitative.
criteria.findings: Identity and plan envelope are well supported; no new round-11 pointwise GIS overlay was run.

criteria.name: position, orientation, and dimensions
criteria.evidence: The saved local frame and placement origin are reported unchanged; the existing shell bounds are retained. The round-11 exported extent reaches X=19.136 m while the cited shell reaches X=12.981 m, so roof projection extends about 6.15 m beyond the shell on that side.
criteria.findings: Location continuity is supported, but facade bearing/dimensions are estimates and the roof overhang/projection is conspicuously large relative to the unchanged wall envelope.

criteria.name: height, floors, and roof
criteria.evidence: The historical Purdue timeline supports 17 entrance steps. The official photo supports a red-clay roof, but has no calibration. The round-11 edit raised roof rise by 1.8x; export top is Z=15.84 m versus cited shell top Z=11.5 m.
criteria.findings: The roof reads much taller and broader than its facade in the saved overview. Roof rise/profile and upper floor heights lack measurable source evidence; the increase is explicitly estimated.

criteria.name: facade, entrance, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Round 11 adds segmented stone portal voussoirs, pilasters/capitals, an arched transom, and two lower arched window surrounds. These address signature arches visible in the official exterior photo; brick/stone palette and roof tile color are improved.
criteria.findings: The render remains simplified and heavily planar compared with the photo; masonry hierarchy and the roof-to-facade proportion still need refinement. Opening dimensions and detailing are estimated from perspective imagery.

criteria.name: modular export, portability, and evidence
criteria.evidence: Exact SHA matched; the exact asset reopened in Blender 5.2.3. Stable export collection is Asset_felix_haas_hall with 919 objects / 879 meshes; round-11 BVH report found no new-to-existing surface intersections; no external images or image-texture nodes were reported. Builder provides official source links, uncertainty, renders, and intersection evidence.
criteria.findings: The shared manifest is stale: it still records 879 objects and local max Z=14.0, versus reopened export 919 objects and max Z=15.84000015258789. Interior is explicitly schematic.

findings: The new arches and stone surround improve the signature facade compared with round 10.
The red tile material is more legible, but the roof dominates the saved overview; its rise was increased without calibrated height evidence.
The roof projection extends about 6.15 m beyond the unchanged shell in the X-positive direction; validate the overhang against source evidence.
Manifest object count is stale (879 vs 919); round-11 master integration must refresh the shared count/bounds.
Interior plan is schematic and correctly labeled as nondimensional; no evidence supports treating it as a verified interior.
priority_fixes: Recheck the broad/tall roof silhouette and X-positive overhang using additional elevations, aerial/LiDAR, or a better-calibrated source; reduce unsupported projection/height if evidence warrants.
Refine the large facade fields and stone/brick hierarchy to better match the official photograph without inventing unsupported dimensions.
Update manifest count/bounds only after this exact asset version is accepted and integrated.
